visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short black hair, wearing a black and white horizontal striped crop top and light blue denim shorts, stands outdoors on an asphalt surface next to a green Honda motorcycle. She holds a silver smartphone in her left hand, looking at it with a neutral expression. The background features green trees and a paved area. Lighting is bright natural daylight. (2) She attempts to mount the motorcycle, and the smartphone accidentally slips from her hand. A close-up shot follows the phone as it tumbles through the air and bounces multiple times on the gray cobblestone pavement. (3) The woman is now kneeling on the pavement, holding the phone and looking relieved. She speaks directly to the camera, gesturing with her right hand. (4) The video transitions to close-up shots of the phone case, showing various designs with character stickers. This is followed by a digital CG animation showing the internal "AirX" blue cushioning structure and structural grid of the case. (5) A brief clip shows a motorcycle racer in a blue and white suit with an integrated airbag vest inflating during a fall on a racetrack. (6) The woman is back on screen standing next to the motorcycle, holding multiple phone cases with different designs like Anpanman and Pokemon. She points to the sides of the case and demonstrates the tactile buttons. (7) She drops the phone on the ground again from waist height to prove its durability, then picks it up to show the screen is perfectly intact. (8) A screen recording displays a website catalog featuring branded designs for Ducati and Red Bull Racing. (9) Finally, the woman sits on the ground in front of the motorcycle, holding three phone cases and smiling broadly while explaining a promotional offer for the 11.11 sale.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched female voice speaks with high arousal and rising intonation while high-tempo electronic pop music with a steady 128 BPM beat plays. (2) A synthesized cartoon-style "boing" SFX triggers as a phone is visually dropped. (3) The female voice continues at a rapid speech rate with clear articulation, accompanied by upbeat synth layers. (4) A male voice-over transitions in with a professional, authoritative narrative tone, explaining technical details while the BGM volume is slightly ducked. (5) Percussive "thud" and digital "whoosh" SFXs mark transitions between tech demonstration clips. (6) Multiple UI "ding" sounds occur as text labels appear on screen. (7) The female voice returns with a friendly and enthusiastic tone, explaining sales details. (8) BGM builds in harmonic complexity towards the finale, ending with a sharp impact SFX and a quick fade.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook (Simulated Accident) -> Tech Solution (Cushioning Tech) -> Proof of Durability -> Catalog Variety -> CTA (Discount Offer)
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote RHINOSHIELD's AirX phone cases by demonstrating their superior impact protection using a motorcycle-related hook and offering a 11.11 shopping festival discount.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct product demonstration, verbal recommendation, and discount code for the brand.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A highly produced social-native advertisement utilizing fast-paced editing and multimodal reinforcement to drive consumer sales during a major shopping holiday.
